name: FNAL-E-0053
full_name: Fermilab Experiment E53, neutrino-neon bubble-chamber programme
summary: Fermilab E53 used the 15-foot chamber with heavy neon-containing fills to study high-energy neutrino interactions, rare leptonic channels, charm and short-baseline oscillations.
physics_targets: Neutrino-electron elastic scattering and electroweak couplings
Charm, coherent pion production and oscillation tests
detection_principle: A dense neon-hydrogen liquid increased interaction and electromagnetic-conversion probability while bubble photographs resolved charged tracks. Electron showers, muon tracks and secondary decays identified elastic scattering, hadronic events and charm candidates.

results.summary: Measured the elastic-scattering cross section and inferred a weak mixing angle consistent with other contemporary determinations.
